name: _template
description: Starter template. Copy this file, rename it (e.g., my-cluster.json), and fill in the values. Remove all _notes_* keys when done.
_notes_top: Top-level fields. 'name' should match the filename without .json. 'required_user_fields' lists dotted paths inside 'cluster' (or elsewhere) that MUST be non-empty before script generation; the wizard prompts for them on first use.

cluster._notes_scheduler: Only 'slurm' is supported in v1. PBS/SGE is reserved for future versions.
cluster._notes_account: Site-specific allocation/account identifier. Leave empty in a shared profile; the wizard asks the user on first load.
cluster._notes_qos: Quality-of-service name if your site uses it. Leave empty if unused.
cluster._notes_modules: List of module load strings issued verbatim after `module purge` in the generated script. Use the exact names your site provides.
cluster._notes_conda_env: If set, the generated script activates this conda env after module loads.
cluster._notes_pre_commands: Bash lines injected after module loads, before the pmemd invocation. Use for env vars, cd, staging, etc.
cluster._notes_post_commands: Bash lines injected after pmemd completes.
cluster._notes_extra_directives: Extra #SBATCH lines (without the '#SBATCH ' prefix) for anything the schema doesn't cover, e.g. '--exclusive' or '--constraint=a100'.

_notes_resource_classes: Named hardware profiles. 'mode' must be 'cpu' or 'gpu'. 'binary' is usually 'pmemd.MPI' for cpu or 'pmemd.cuda' for gpu. 'gres' is documentation — the script uses the GPU type parsed from it plus the 'gpus' count. 'default_time' is the fallback wall-time; run plans override per step. 'mpi_launcher' prefixes the binary (use 'srun', or 'srun --mpi=<plugin>' — see _notes_mpi_launcher). 'env_vars' inject 'export KEY=VALUE' lines before the binary. 'output_pattern' / 'error_pattern' use '{job_name}' (substituted at script-write time) and '%j' (SLURM job ID).
_notes_mpi_launcher: Use 'srun' for MPI binaries (pmemd.MPI, pmemd.cuda.MPI), NOT 'mpirun'. Under Slurm with TaskPlugin=task/affinity, 'mpirun' launches its proxy as a single Slurm task that gets pinned to one core, and every MPI rank it forks inherits that single-core cpuset — so an N-rank job time-shares one core (~N x slowdown). 'srun' makes Slurm bind each rank to its own core. The required PMI plugin is SITE-SPECIFIC: set 'srun --mpi=<plugin>' to match your cluster. Run 'scontrol show config | grep MpiDefault' and 'srun --mpi=list'. If MpiDefault=none you MUST name a plugin or ranks get no PMI bootstrap. MPICH-linked AMBER -> 'srun --mpi=pmi2'; OpenMPI-linked AMBER -> 'srun --mpi=pmix'. Leave empty for serial/single-GPU (non-MPI) binaries.
_notes_defaults: Which resource class fulfills each mode when the Amber-recommendation classifier decides cpu vs gpu. Class names must appear in resource_classes above.
